game_concept: A arcade set in Shadow Cave – Echo Chamber, a booming echo chamber: the spelunker must handle skeleton miners while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Break Out: Use break to leave a loop the moment a dangerous foe is spotted.
theme: Shadow Cave – Echo Chamber: a booming echo chamber
core_gameplay_loop: In Echo Chamber, repeat each round: Use break to leave a loop the moment a dangerous foe is spotted. Each round, a new pickaxes challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the alert value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 130 points of pickaxes by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 130, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 3 (intro tier): Break Out
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Break Out' (Week 4 slot 10), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Echo Chamber'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how alert changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against skeleton miners in Echo Chamber.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 130 within 50 seconds.
